said.q: Collages of that date are sober, dignified, highly geometric compositions
At the same time, however, the number of bold figure-ground contrasts is reduced, to achieve greater force, and the surrounding materials are kept closer to each other tonally

A wonderful example of Kurt Schwitters’ Merzzeichnungen (Merz Drawings), Mz 30,3, 1930 is a colorful construction that perfectly typifies the German artist’s signature collage works, commenced in 1919 and sustained until the end of his life in 1948.
